paragraphs: Hello! I am Tom. Today Mom cleans the clothes. Look at the picture. Mom puts the clothes on a line in the garden. This is a sock. It is red. These are trousers. They are black. Dad wears these trousers to the shop. This is a dress. Lily wears the dress at home. This is my shirt. It is white and very big.

Now look at the kitchen. Mom is in the kitchen with Dad and me. This is a pineapple. A pineapple is a big yellow fruit. I like it a lot. This is a potato. It is brown. Dad likes potatoes. We eat potatoes and rice for dinner. We eat the pineapple with our dinner, too.
Now I ask you four questions. Do you wear socks to school? Do you wear a dress or trousers? Do you like pineapple? Do you eat potatoes? Tell me, and I tell you.
text.summary: Tom shows the clothes on the washing line and the food in the kitchen. He names a sock, trousers, a pineapple, and a potato.
